summary: URGENT: User showed email that GitHub token named 'Walk this Way' is expiring. Investigated and found user has TWO tokens: (1) expiring 'Walk this Way' token stored in macOS Keychain (used by git push/pull), (2) no-expiration token in ~/.zshrc (used only by MCP env var). Git uses osxkeychain credential helper, so when the expiring token dies, git operations will break. Need to either regenerate at github.com/settings/tokens/2636567763/regenerate with no expiration, or replace Keychain entry with the no-expiration token.
current_status: Walk_This_Way repo confirmed safe on GitHub (private repo). Git operations still working. Token expiration imminent. Awaiting user action to regenerate or consolidate tokens.
